title: Aliens Trap Jerry in a Simulation Part 2

series.summary: Rick uses the shower to evade the prudish Zigerian scammers while the alien crew accidentally abducts Jerry and throttles his simulation to five percent.

cuts.voiceover_text: Rick drags Morty into a running shower for one bizarre reason: their alien captors are utterly terrified of nudity. He reveals that they are trapped by Zigerian scammers, the galaxy's most ambitious yet incompetent con artists. As long as they stay completely naked under the rushing water, the prudish aliens refuse to monitor them. Morty panics and desperately begs to return to his simulated school crush, but Rick firmly pins him down under the stream to keep them safe and undetected.

Meanwhile, up on the alien command deck, Prince Nebulon and his crew refuse to glance at the shower monitor in utter disgust. Suddenly, red warning alarms flash across the bridge as a massive processing surge suddenly strains their simulation engine. The crew panics in total confusion, quickly discovering an unexpected second real human trapped inside the virtual world. On the main viewscreen, Jerry Smith appears, completely oblivious to danger as he rehearses a disastrous advertising pitch inside his car. The abductions officer and the simulations director immediately erupt into a frantic argument, each desperately insisting the catastrophic mix-up was not their fault. Prince Nebulon cuts through their chaotic bickering with biting sarcasm, observing that Jerry is so remarkably clueless he has not even noticed his entire reality is artificial. Instead of releasing him, the alien prince orders Jerry's sector processing power throttled down to a bare five percent on auto-pilot to conserve system resources. With Jerry neutralized in a low-power loop, Nebulon turns back to the central console with chilling focus: Rick Sanchez is their true target, and the trap is about to spring.
